limits: The initial harness misclassified a later directory sync after verification-sidecar removal as another intent sync. It stopped after the successful CLI exit on both platforms. A separate verifier checked the saved exit results, event ordering, manifests and a fresh CLI inventory. The deletion was not repeated.

The storage fault was injected and the restarts were an APFS detach/reattach and a Docker restart. A physical power interruption, physical storage fault, filesystem device-number change and a host reboot were not exercised.

The archived CVDs were used to test deletion and preservation. This was not a fresh official download, an elapsed provider wait, another successful first publication, or a 429 trial. The full automated suite was not rerun for this acceptance-only change.
